rationale: Build on the recurrent-tail baseline with a compact validation-aligned curriculum: keep the reverse-tail recurrence path intact, but gradually upweight the final 64 positions of each training sequence late in the run, matching the eval stride regime without changing final evaluation or export behavior. The edit stays compile-stable, reuses the existing masked-loss path, and removes now-unused training helpers instead of growing the file much.
title: Late Tail-Loss Curriculum
